data_fields.name: frame_target_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: 22 low, 24 medium, 22 high, 30 ultra, 30 insane (drop threshold)

best_idea: Admit background prep units (shader compiles, texture uploads, zone prep) into each frame against a headroom computed from the frame-time average and the tier target, learn each unit kind's cost by EMA, and guarantee progress with one slot per frame and a starvation bound so a piece is delayed but never dropped.
decision_why: Keep the per-frame headroom, the cost ledger and the starvation bound; they stop a slow phone frame from being loaded with prep while never dropping a piece. Fix the 64-kind overflow and the 48-character kind key in the successor, and state the starvation bound in ms per tier so a phone tier does not wait twice as long as desktop.
acceptance: Client unit test: 40 ms frames against a 22 ms phone target with a 6 ms visible piece; the piece starts within 30 frames, actionable units start in the frame they arrive, a cosmetic piece starts within 240 frames, and no submitted piece is dropped.
